stem: One aisle PPFD reading meets target while crop complaints occur under the center canopy. What is the best next step?
choices: Map representative crop-plane locations using consistent orientation and height.
Use the aisle reading as proof the canopy is uniform.
Change photoperiod before measuring the affected area.
rationale: Map representative crop-plane locations using consistent orientation and height. This preserves the evidence and role boundary required by the referenced verification framework.
